title: Outdoor Baked Canadian Corn Tacos
description: A cultured and pillowy Canadian dish featuring corn tortillas and a mirepoix base, perfect for outdoor gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the outdoor oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the mirepoix mix to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix the diced tomatoes and shredded cheese.
In a terracotta dish, arrange a layer of corn tortillas.
Spoon the beef and mirepoix mixture over the tortillas.
Top the beef mixture with the tomato and cheese mixture.
Bake the tacos in the outdoor oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the tacos from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
